description: Design requirements, not implemented/proved claims. Paths are repository-relative. `keystones` names the certified theorems that carry an advanced status; `note` says what the status covers and what it does not.

requirements.title: Immutable content and explicit digest conflicts
requirements.implementation_note: Logical payload bindings are immutable; real digest binding/collision handling remains open.
requirements.note: The immutable payload binding has scoped keystones under OBJ-002. SHA-256 and content-identity derivation now exist in executable ACL2; their existence does not establish complete conflict handling across native signatures, projections, transit and recovery. This requirement remains specified pending that composed evidence.

requirements.title: Distinct exact Message-ID and content/local identities
requirements.implementation_note: Exact Message-ID strings, content subjects and local numbers remain distinct. Article-field extraction validates the RFC identifier grammar and preserves exact octets. The actual standalone Store and configured owner prepare/query wrappers call fn-sn-existing-action over their live composed Store; it returns duplicate only for the held Message-ID with equal payload octets and ordered groups, conflict for a held differing binding, and nil for no binding. Native identity/signature composition remains open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). The exact Message-ID binding survives completion and recovery, and a successful parse reconstructs its exact source octets, so the wire identity, the content subject and the local number stay three things. Open: native identity and signature composition, and the digest side of OBJ-001. T3 removes the host duplicate/conflict decision twin; the ACL2 theorem and reachable teeth cover this live Store comparison. This does not establish legacy source-variant comparison, network composition, or digest collision handling.

requirements.title: Preserved source variants and honest provenance
requirements.implementation_note: The selected native preimage binds exact authored source octets, principal and ordered enrolled hybrid keys. The selected kind-4 schema-1 constructor stores the received FN-Authorship article in its embedded record and separately retains the exact source and ACL2-derived source identity; its replay binder checks received-source projection and the enrolled ordered key set. Mutable Path/Xref and gateway injection records remain outside that source. Combined native recovery, reader exposure and legacy-variant comparison/quarantine remain open.
requirements.note: No book states a source-variant or provenance property. D01 selected the source boundary; the native grammar and the legacy-variant comparison/quarantine policy are unwritten, and PRF-013 has no events.

requirements.title: Conflicting evidence is not resolved by arrival time
requirements.implementation_note: Exchange retains competing content/provenance facts and reports conflict without arrival-time selection.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). Admission retains conflicting evidence rather than overwriting it, and membership of the merge does not depend on ingestion order, so no arrival-time rule decides a conflict. Scope: the merge is over validated fact sets supplied to fn-exchange; authorization and signatures are inputs, not proved here.

requirements.title: Atomic local memberships and non-reused article numbers
requirements.implementation_note: Logical acceptance has atomic membership and general number/binding preservation proofs.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). Allocation is at the watermark, conflicts with no installed number, and a durable completion installs exactly the pending article. Open: fn-allocate-at-watermark still carries hypotheses H1/H2 that core's report records as droppable once fn-watermark-bump-other is restated without its membership-list hypothesis.

requirements.title: Origin identity/incarnation independent of wall-clock order
requirements.note: PRF-017 has no events. Origin identity and incarnation are records the host writes; no theorem relates them to a non-wall-clock order. The E2 clone source now requires a fresh caller-supplied incarnation and durably publishes the ACL2 rollover before releasing a fence, but this does not close PRF-017 for arbitrary origin issuance or time-independent fork authority; native qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Native author signatures, legacy provenance, scoped authority
requirements.implementation_note: D09 requires both Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 over ACL2's exact authored-source preimage. The native primitives and ACL2 conjunction fail closed for absent, invalid or unsupported components. Kind-4 schema 1 retains the received carrier, exact authored source, its identity, enrolled snapshot and historical verdict; replay checks their structural binding without recomputing present keyring capability. A legacy fn-r record contains no verdict bytes: its live verification observation is explicitly non-durable and recovery reports no historical verdict. Persisting equivalent legacy authority remains an implemented-behavior evidence gap; key custody, reader exposure and combined native recovery qualification remain open.
requirements.note: PRF-013 has no events. books/crypto-seam and books/statement certify, but they are an abstract seam: nothing there is a real signature, and AGENTS.md forbids reading an abstract model as a signature claim.

requirements.title: Deterministic encoding and value round trips
requirements.implementation_note: Primitive/schema-0 full round trips and accepted-input canonicality certified; 38 independent cbor2 cases pass. Explicit-budget deterministic byte strings admit bounded keyring and accepted-statement Store events above the legacy generic ceiling while old entry points retain their exact contracts. Native signature preimages remain open. Since T1 (plan 2026-09-22 §4.1) the record codec is behind a seam: fn-record-round-trip and fn-record-accepted-input-is-canonical are constraints of books/records-seam.lisp over the constrained fn-record-encode and fn-record-decode-exact that the host and every book above the codec call, and fn-record-impl-round-trip and fn-record-impl-accepted-input-is-canonical are the same properties of the implementation books/records-attach.lisp attaches. The header is two constraints, fn-record-accepted-input-magic and fn-record-accepted-schema-is-the-stamp-kind, so the acceptance stamp's schema 1 widens the grammar behind the seam; the exact octets are the concrete fact fn-record-schema0-golden-octets-are-the-encoding of books/records.lisp, since a round trip and canonicality do not identify the wire language.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). Round trip and accepted-input canonicality hold for the CBOR primitives, the schema-0 transaction record and the BP ADU. Scope: these are fn's own provisional formats; no native object, signature-preimage or batch format is frozen.

requirements.title: Bounded parsing without Lisp evaluation
requirements.implementation_note: Wire event accounting, article syntax recognition/component bounds, UTF-8 scalar/progress bounds, wildmat parser/matcher correspondence, and CBOR/record guard verification are certified. The explicit-budget CBOR path checks whole input and declared byte-string length before allocation; large keyring/composite and overbound witnesses exercise the actual Store dispatcher. Untrusted input still uses bounded octet marshalling. Full host graph guards remain open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). Every parser in the served path is an ACL2 definition over octet lists with a certified input bound; nothing calls the Lisp reader or evaluator. The pessimistic number, with its scope: the closed-form work ceiling of the public article parser is roughly 16,000x the measured traversal cost of that same parser on the same inputs (tests/evidence/2026-09-18-article-work.md), and it is an instrumented shadow of the parser, not a measurement of host CPU, memory, GC or I/O.

requirements.title: Versioned domain-separated hash/signature preimages
requirements.implementation_note: The version-1 hybrid preimage is domain separated and length delimits exact authored source after fixed-width principal and ordered algorithm-tagged enrolled keys. Both standard pure signatures cover these bytes directly.
requirements.note: This is the native authored-source signature context; other formats retain separately scoped preimages.

requirements.title: Explicit schema evolution and opaque unknown objects
requirements.note: T2a implements schema-1 acceptance stamps with exact schema-0 decode/re-encode as :legacy; the codec and replay properties have lane certification. Native carried-over Store qualification on the combined image remains open. Unknown article headers and body bytes remain preserved, but opaque re-encoding of an unknown record schema is still unimplemented; this broader requirement is not complete.

requirements.title: Authoritative committed state and complete derived indexes
requirements.implementation_note: Immutable local transaction files are replayed by ACL2 into complete node articles, memberships, and pins. Format-7 profiles derive a 196608-octet payload ceiling from persisted aggregate/count metadata; format-6 remains readable at 65538 and must refuse larger publication before mutation. In-memory Message-ID and LISTGROUP group-bucket indexes correspond to each connection's pinned accepted archive; no disk index is authoritative. GROUP, NEXT, LAST and NEWNEWS remain archive folds.
requirements.note: The T17 in-memory Message-ID trie serves exact-ID ARTICLE, HEAD, BODY and STAT. The separate per-group bucket now serves LISTGROUP through the actual owner/served dispatcher under exact per-view/per-connection archive correspondence. Scoped ACL2 proof and historical owner-call tests are recorded in planning/evidence/t17-group-bucket-served-2026-09-23.md. The structural 24-group cost fixture is not elapsed-time qualification; integrated native image and combined closure remain pending.

requirements.title: Atomic acceptance includes memberships and obligations
requirements.implementation_note: Actual CLI persists one complete cross-post with archive obligation, then publishes through the same ACL2 node. General physical transaction/refinement theorem remains open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). One transaction stages the acceptance and its reservation, completion publishes both, and finite actual node traces preserve prior bindings. Open: the disk observations the node consumes are still abstract inputs at this layer; STO-003 to STO-005 carry the durable half.

requirements.title: Success follows a matching durable commit
requirements.implementation_note: Actual file/kernel completion ordering and arbitrary finite stable-history/success-prefix proofs are certified; composed live completion calls actual node semantics before acknowledgement. Real syscall/process-death tests pass. Full adapter adoption/refinement and qualified physical persistence remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open. W13 supplies the exact fresh-initializer image theorem and executable injective transaction-name attachment (PRF-044). The configuration-history fence witness distinguishes this image from the weaker existing relation. Source review and selected failures do not establish all host cuts, existing/retry initialization, native correspondence or general recovery. W18 adds explicit existing-valid and history-fenced retry programs with EEXIST observations, plus source-pinned native repeated-init and SIGKILL/reopen tests. Non-EEXIST publication errors are uncertain. These are selected branch/runtime results, not whole-host or power-loss correspondence; the followup classifier covers expected-EEXIST links, and separate link/barrier handlers preserve uncertainty for post-link errors. Integrated raw-handler tests also exercise the named post-link error cut. Whole-image validation of these later corrections remains separate.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). A new success in the composed machine requires an actual matching durable node completion, in single steps and across mixed live/refusal/recovery traces. Open: the refinement from these file events to real syscalls remains conditional on the platform assumptions in the trust boundary; no power-loss profile is qualified.

requirements.title: Uncertain persistence fences mutations pending recovery
requirements.implementation_note: Recovery/read/publication/completion faults fence mutations; 47 injected cases and six process-death boundaries preserve the applicable obligations. Closed/read-only owners now reject mutation and lock lifecycle regressions pass. Live wrapper adoption and physical refinement remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open. W12 adds bounded ACL2 FNFD prefix recovery, durable torn-suffix repair and an owner-wide fence after ambiguous journal I/O. Its scanner/phase theorems and component tests are scoped by PRF-043; physical correspondence and integrated acceptance/feed recovery remain open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). An uncertain publication fences the machine: start, prepare and success are all rejected while fenced, and an incomplete recovery barrier does not reach ready. The three outcomes stay distinct out to the CLI exit codes (accepted 0, refused 1, uncertain 3) in the deploy gate. Open: an injected uncertain publication leaves a staging orphan that recovery reports and does not collect, and no registry row owns that choice.

requirements.title: Recovery preserves acknowledged commits without partial transactions
requirements.implementation_note: General finite file traces retain earlier acknowledged records under named stable-storage and ghost-history premises, and across a real reopen under fn-sf-crash-imagep (A-DURABILITY as hypothesis); the bounded exploration with a txid-gap record, fault injection and actual process reopen/lost-success retries pass, with designated process-death cuts represented in the experimental model. Complete current-host syscall/cut fidelity remains open: the metadata initializer omits lock/config-history operations and helper parent barriers (PRF-044). Freshness, host composition and platform qualification remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open. W13 supplies the exact fresh-initializer image theorem and executable injective transaction-name attachment (PRF-044). The configuration-history fence witness distinguishes this image from the weaker existing relation. Source review and selected failures do not establish all host cuts, existing/retry initialization, native correspondence or general recovery. W18 adds explicit existing-valid and history-fenced retry programs with EEXIST observations, plus source-pinned native repeated-init and SIGKILL/reopen tests. Non-EEXIST publication errors are uncertain. These are selected branch/runtime results, not whole-host or power-loss correspondence; the followup classifier covers expected-EEXIST links, and separate link/barrier handlers preserve uncertainty for post-link errors. Integrated raw-handler tests also exercise the named post-link error cut. Whole-image validation of these later corrections remains separate. Native transaction recovery now observes a bounded namespace and consumes ACL2-issued sequence/name pairs before binding each decoded record. The source-matched developer store image passed malformed-name and sequence-mismatch cases; configuration namespace recovery and general physical correspondence remain open. Native publication uncertainty now has focused byte-transition and exact fn-sn-io fence theorems for issued link, issued rename, and both authority-directory barrier errors. This is logical K7 scope; the exact-octet native SIGKILL run, general K0/K5/K6/K8, filesystem qualification and hardware power-loss correspondence remain open. 2026-09-22 (t5/sweep, campaign finding F2): recovery sweeps every staging prefix a host program uses, in bounded rounds decided by fn-sn-sweep-round; a store of N crash orphans opens for every N (fn-sn-sweep-rounds-collect-every-orphan), and the sweep is a stutter of the byte relation at every cut (K-sweep, PRF-041). More than one observation of unrecognized staging names is refused (exit 1), not faulted.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). An acknowledged record survives an observed reopen and a mixed trace, and reopen yields the exact history. Real evidence at the process level: the deploy gate SIGKILLed the server from inside an open POST, the interrupted article was absent after recovery, and the article acknowledged before the kill reread byte-for-byte through a fresh server. The 14-cut campaign on an image is T5; power loss is T16b.

requirements.title: Checkpoints preserve complete future-relevant state
requirements.implementation_note: Logical checkpoint equivalence and concrete codec/publication are implemented. Native capture/select/status validate selected checkpoints after authoritative full journal replay; private restored state is never installed as the live node. ACL2 owns canonical namespace and observation/allocation bounds. Mismatch is always corruption, and uncertain mutation leaves the Store fenced. Schema-0 pre-stamp selected checkpoints migrate five-field ready articles to :legacy in ACL2, then pass the current checkpoint recognizer; schema-1 captures keep the new shape. A pre-T2 physical checkpoint exposed a T2 decode failure before this repair; patched ACL2 decodes its exact frame with :legacy, while an exact-source repaired native image remains to be run. Source-pinned component tests do not establish suffix-only recovery, shared-owner/index integration, full physical correspondence or freshness qualification. Selected-pack exact-history reopen now has a version-one recovery-only ACL2 differential for E2 consumer state, completed dense sequence, historical verdicts and keyring snapshots; the source-pinned ACL2 witness covers a reclaimed E2 prefix and a bound hybrid composite. The native caller is wired but awaits a combined image witness. Cold writable clone activation remains unimplemented and must not be inferred from copying a store directory. The native source adds fenced cold clone/clone-resume with an ACL2-proposed durable E2 rollover event and no-replace directory publication. Its ACL2 phase tests certify; a combined saved-image crash/reopen run has not yet qualified this physical path.
requirements.note: The earlier logical-only certification remains evidence for its stated theorem. W15 adds separately source-pinned native image tests of capture, selection, corruption and selected crash cuts; it does not certify current integrated owner behavior or every physical crash cut.

requirements.title: Compaction preserves protected content across crashes
requirements.note: A lossless selected prefix pack now permits exact prefix-file reclamation and crash resumption while preserving every canonical Store event byte. Surviving covered files must match the pack and the uncovered suffix must be contiguous. Focused source and ACL2 tests do not yet establish active-reader safety, all physical crash cuts, filesystem qualification, or protected-closure reclamation of article objects.

requirements.title: Detected corruption has an explicit fault and repair path
requirements.implementation_note: Real frame checksum/truncation/schema/namespace faults refuse normal recovery. Repair workflow and old-valid-store rollback detection remain open. W12 adds bounded ACL2 FNFD prefix recovery, durable torn-suffix repair and an owner-wide fence after ambiguous journal I/O. Its scanner/phase theorems and component tests are scoped by PRF-043; physical correspondence and integrated acceptance/feed recovery remain open. Composed recovery now faults on identity replay failure even when embedded article replay succeeds; the missing-enrollment kind-4 trace runs against actual fn-sn-open-observed definitions. Fresh certification and native corrupt-history startup remain open.
requirements.note: Frame integrity evidence is scoped by PRF-035. W12 repairs only a torn final FNFD envelope; complete invalid evidence is preserved and fails startup. General media repair, durable staging orphan collection and old-valid-store rollback detection remain open.

requirements.title: Crash model includes torn/reordered writes and explicit barriers
requirements.implementation_note: Abstract isolated-slot model plus real adapter barriers and injected failures. No claim that the slot model is already a proved refinement of this adapter or a qualified power-loss model. Native publication uncertainty now has focused byte-transition and exact fn-sn-io fence theorems for issued link, issued rename, and both authority-directory barrier errors. This is logical K7 scope; the exact-octet native SIGKILL run, general K0/K5/K6/K8, filesystem qualification and hardware power-loss correspondence remain open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). The crash relation realizes every admissible image, stable records are a prefix of any crash image, and the five barriers are what open a reopened store. Open, and named by review finding D4: the images are record-granular. Byte-level torn writes are planning/lanes/DESIGN-crash-model-v2-summary.md (K1 to K11), a design, so 'every crash point' is not claimed for the byte layer. The recovery-window gap decision D14-a named is CLOSED at the kernel by decision D14-b (2026-09-20, lane w10/kernel-freedom), in a shape that decision did not propose. fn-sf-recovery-crash-imagep is a second recognizer for what the platform may leave -- the stable list, that list plus the data-durable candidate, or, in the recovery window with an empty success history, that list without its last element -- and it is used as the conclusion of crash-model-v2 K2, never as a reopen premise. fn-sf-crash-imagep is unchanged: widening it is FALSE for the composition, because an owner reopened on an image is a recovery-window state whose own success history is empty while its LEDGER names records earlier processes acknowledged, and which of a state's records are fenced is a fact about the byte store's pending list rather than about the kernel state. The counterexample is mechanized in tests/acl2/owner-tests.lisp and tests/acl2/store-observed-traces-tests.lisp. What the kernel now proves is fn-sf-recovery-admissible-image-facts: an acknowledged pair names a record of every image the platform may leave, the rolled-back one included. Still open: the frontier sub-case K2f, where the recovery window is entered with a pending frontier rename and a crash rolls the frontier back to a value the kernel does not hold.

requirements.title: Known abort, uncertainty, and lost volatile state are distinct
requirements.implementation_note: Uncertain publication/completion fences mutation. File-kernel traces and real Store recovery have scoped evidence; sender binding covers uncertain completion/restart/recovery. Five actual BP receiver process-death cuts distinguish durable staging, article, context, pending intent requiring explicit recovery, and committed receipt before deletion. General physical byte/host correspondence remains open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). Known abort, uncertainty and lost volatile state are three distinct transitions in the file machine, and the distinction reaches the operator: the deploy gate drove all three through the real CLI and got exit codes 0, 1 and 3. Open: the campaign's cut table is the enumeration of process deaths, and two of its cuts are still 'gap' pending the byte-level crash model.

requirements.title: Media corruption and node loss have separately scoped claims
requirements.note: No proof target and no media/node-loss model.

requirements.title: Delay, replay, clock error, and liveness assumptions are explicit
requirements.note: PRF-017 and PRF-018 have no events. books/clock and books/anchor certify and books/assumptions holds the constrained A-* functions, but docs/proofs.md records that no theorem in the tree takes one of those constraints as a hypothesis yet, so the delay and liveness assumptions are declared, not applied. w11/anchor-root (D22) closed the divergence w11/one-owner found: fn-anchor-root is a record field, not (fn-anchor-leaf-digest (fn-anchor-nonce a)), so fn-anchor-signed-octets is the message the host verified for a response of any batch size, and fn-anchor-signed-octets-determine-the-root now covers every response rather than the empty-PATH case only. fn-anchor-one-nonce-p is a branch of every transition answering :uncertain :unmodelled-tree, so a batched response is never accepted. The host-entry hypothesis is two values, one per A-CRYPTO seam (fn-anchor-signatures-okp and fn-anchor-one-nonce-p), both computed in tools/run_store.py anchor_verdict and Anchor.one_nonce; the mint<=midpoint<=maxt conjunct moved into fn-anchor-verifiedp-observed, so tools/roughtime.py's copy is a preflight and no longer half the discharge. Correction to the earlier note and to w11/one-owner: the vectors were NOT all single-nonce -- tests/vectors/roughtime-int08h-2026-09-19-later2.json has a one-node PATH and INDX 1, so the divergence was live in fn's own tests, not hypothetical. Still open and now a feature item: there is no SHA-512 in the tree, tools/roughtime.py's _leaf/_node/merkle_root remain unowned (recorded as a trusted facility in specs/anchor.md), and fn therefore cannot use a batched Roughtime response at all. PRF-017 still has no curated events in planning/proof-events.json.

requirements.title: Persist scoped accepted obligations before receipts
requirements.implementation_note: Real local records persist the archive obligation with content; recovered article-to-pin relations checked. Forwarding receipts remain unimplemented.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). An obligation is admitted into retention state inside the same transaction that stages the acceptance, and a known obligation id is never reused. Open: the scope on the obligation is an abstract pin, charging units are abstract rather than measured physical bytes, and RET-004's authorization check is not proved.

requirements.title: Reserve capacity and refuse unaffordable obligations
requirements.implementation_note: Abstract reservations compose with acceptance; local adapter also refuses configured bounds and tests duplicates at capacity. Physical-space reservation accounting remains open.
requirements.note: T11's keystone, fn-retain-admit-refuses-unaffordable-obligation (books/retention-invariants.lisp), states the refusal: whenever a charge exceeds the room the capacity leaves, fn-retain-admit answers the input state unchanged, with a fn-retain-statep hypothesis proved unnecessary (admission already refuses every non-state through fn-retain-admissiblep's first conjunct). fn-node-prepare (books/node.lisp:185-188), the one function through which every reachable caller (POST via fn-sn-prepare-node, peer transit via fn-peer-decide-transfer, the config and BP-receiver replay paths) proposes an obligation, tests the identical fn-retain-admissiblep call before it would reach fn-retain-admit, so this keystone accounts for its refusal too. Teeth in tests/acl2/retention-tests.lisp: a capacity-10 ledger with 6 reserved refuses a charge of 5 and admits the same obligation at charge 4. Charges remain abstract units, not measured physical bytes, which is why AGENTS.md's twins rule still bites: physical-space reservation accounting is open (implementation_note).

requirements.title: Receipts distinguish transmission, retention, and delivery
requirements.implementation_note: Actual sender workflow distinguishes transport observations from committed matching application receipts; finite transport traces preserve receipt decisions. The trusted loopback BP exchange and fixed-Store receiver decision/replay proofs are integrated. Concrete authenticated undertaking and full cooperative-peer handoff remain open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). Transport steps preserve the receipt rather than creating one, an unchecked receipt is a no-op, and a receipt success requires the local policy decision and an actual journal preparation, so transmission, retention and delivery stay three things. Open: receipts are unsigned and A-POLICY is trusted; no authenticated remote receipt.

requirements.title: Release requires matching committed authorized evidence
requirements.implementation_note: Exact supplied evidence gates abstract ledger release and preserves unrelated pins. BP sender discharge requires a matching locally authorized committed receipt decision; receiver replayed receipts are grounded in exact ready Store records and matching journal decisions. The native FNWF caller now uses ACL2 constructors and the release-aware interpreter for canonical receipt intent, undertaking and exact matching release; a shared saved-image run remains pending; the host-called replay/status refinement for the extended kinds is certified in books/bp-release-replay-status.lisp. Real D01/D09 authority, complete host refinement and durable node-level archive release remain open; completing onward work does not release either node's archive pin.
requirements.note: Release records its evidence (fn-retain-exact-release-records-its-evidence) and preserves independent pins, but 'authorized' is not proved: the evidence check is a single admit-string equality, not an issuer, nonce, incarnation or authorization check, and PRF-013 has no events.

requirements.title: Reclamation preserves every protected dependency closure
requirements.note: PRF-009 is planned with no events. No reclamation exists.

requirements.title: History pruning has explicit duplicate/resurrection semantics
requirements.note: PRF-009 is planned with no events. D13's history rule is unresolved.

requirements.title: Provenance is a typed value, not a rendered string
requirements.implementation_note: fn-retain-admissiblep, the two retention record fields and fn-node-stagep take fn-provp, which accepts every string as the :legacy kind, so no existing store, journal or checkpoint changes meaning. The POST writer's provenance is decided in ACL2 (fn-store-prov-post) and stored as the canonical wire form; the transit writer's typed record exists (fn-peer-transit-provenance) and is proved to render to the string the transit path writes, but the transit path still stores the rendering.
requirements.note: OPEN, with its obligation in planning/lanes/HANDOFF-w10-provenance.md: the transit path needs a kind formal on fn-peer-decide-transfer, fn-peer-transfer and fn-peer-injection-arguments before it can store the record's wire form, and the two BP drivers still read a host constant for their evidence label.

requirements.title: Exchange portable facts rather than local database identity
requirements.implementation_note: Portable immutable fact model avoids local NNTP identity; no batch serialization yet.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). What crosses is a fact set: admission is by member, an ingest trace preserves the facts it already holds, and no local database identity appears in the exchanged form. Open: portable batch framing, authenticated handoff and local NNTP numbers staying local across a real peering are not proved. 2026-09-22 (T13-conform): what crosses a peer is stored as received except Path (this node's identity and the RFC 5537 3.2.1 diagnostic prepended) and Xref (removed), once, at acceptance, and what is stored is served and fed on (PRF-058; the INN lab found INN's Path and Xref served unchanged). Measured on a node by V0-INN-SERVING-AGENT once an image carries it.

requirements.title: Duplicate/reordered ingestion converges within stated scope
requirements.implementation_note: Duplicate/reordered whole-batch fact merging is tested/proved under explicit capacity/validation conditions.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). The merge is idempotent and order-independent in membership, and an exact duplicate chunk does not overwrite. The stated scope is exactly that: validated fact sets and declared-byte fragments. A byte-identical partial overlap is still a conservative :overlap-conflict with no byte comparison, and convergence across two real peers is the K3 seam, which no book states. Two-node convergence with restart is T9's gate.

requirements.title: Resumable bounded batches validate complete dependencies
requirements.implementation_note: Bounded in-memory fragment assembly has preservation/accounting/gap/work proofs. requirements.title: Durable scheduling with resource and fairness policy
requirements.implementation_note: BPv7 is active M3/M4 work. Durable enqueue, submission intent/outcome, explicit retry decisions, recovered receiver acceptance and returned application receipt are implemented in the bounded laboratory profile. Finite sender traces preserve state/node; scheduling fairness, non-overlapping contact plans and conditional progress remain open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev bdd59d2 (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 213 of 216 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster, the same three as the 7a9e89a gate). A tick is select-drive-take, passed-over work reaches the promotion queue, and the aging bound holds over (nfix n). Two cautions that travel with the status: both aging keystones were FALSE as stated from a018394 until 79e5227 -- at n = 1/2 every run predicate is t and nothing is selected -- and the correction is the (nfix n) horizon, with the counterexample evaluated in tests/acl2/scheduler-tests.lisp. And fn-sched-conditional-progress-under-a-fairness is conditional: it holds under the constrained fn-assume-fairness-contact-index of books/assumptions.lisp, which is an assumption, not a fact about any peer.

requirements.title: BP/LTP preserves fn application acceptance semantics
requirements.implementation_note: Earlier pinned dtn7-rs and development workflow tests retain their recorded scope. Native carrier evidence covers durable allocation, queue/contact/restart/expiry, receive-loop fencing and cross-session evidence retention. The native BP application join now routes request intent through canonical owner Store acceptance, exact committed-record binding and durable receipt decision. Its crash-after-decision/before-receipt witness retries through a fresh process without a second article or retention pin. Full joined trace proof, all physical cuts, authenticated remote evidence, LTP, multi-relay and complete operator integration remain open. The native receipt-decision directory-barrier EIO test also distinguishes visible evidence from durability, fences without emitting a receipt, and replays after recovery barriers. Repeated fn-bpaj retained-state validation remains an active implementation defect; a maintained-invariant successor is assigned. D1a now provides a bounded canonical RFC 9171 status-report codec with whole/fragment and timed-assertion vectors; it does not generate, correlate or consume reports in the node machine. The TCPCL late-disposition planner now replaces a held final END ACK with XFER_REFUSE on definitive refusal and withholds it on uncertainty; its exact native caller and ACL2 proof are source-present, while the A2 FNBS callback and combined-image runtime are pending. The A3 expired-held source checkpoint persists a receive-time age anchor in versioned kind-5 and asks ACL2 for a current pre-Store eligibility decision. The certified A3 local selector now serves a newer live carrier despite an older clock-uncertain carrier, while keeping ambiguous publication globally fenced; affected closure and source-matched native validation remain pending. The D1b kind-10 component now has ACL2-certified exact deletion publication, ordered replay, persisted report payload intent, a recovery outbox selector, administrative outbound authoring and read-only received-report correlation. The native caller is source-present but its source-matched image and death/reopen scenario are still open.
requirements.note: Status remains specified for the full requirement. Implemented native application composition has focused runtime evidence; broader lifecycle/physical obligations remain PRF-045/046. An application receipt is distinct from carrier completion, and neither a scoped test nor an accepted-branch projection theorem establishes full transport independence.

requirements.title: Advertised capabilities match fully audited bundles
requirements.implementation_note: Laboratory reader advertises VERSION/IMPLEMENTATION only; complete planned bundle audit pending.
requirements.note: Refuted by a live counterexample rather than merely unproved: the deploy gate found the server answering POST with 340 while its CAPABILITIES block omits POST, which RFC 3977 section 5.2.2 requires exactly when posting is permitted. Until the advertised bundle and the dispatched bundle are the same list, this requirement is not implemented.

Every dispatched command preserves session consistency, over single steps and finite traces, with the error arms stated separately. Scope, because a board entry reads otherwise: the w5/legacy-commands batch (XOVER, HDR/XHDR, LIST HEADERS/ACTIVE.TIMES) is NOT on dev at c8886ee -- books/nntp-legacy.lisp does not exist and is not a Makefile root -- so the covered commands are the reader bundle as dispatched today, and NNT-001 records that the advertised bundle does not match it.

requirements.title: Bounded framing independent of socket chunk boundaries
requirements.implementation_note: Bounded wire-state preservation, fixed-mode partition theorem, and event-yield/socket boundary tests exist.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). The framing keystones are chunk-independent: the consumed prefix reconstructs the input and feeding is a proper append. The subject rule is met here for the first time: the host no longer owns a :program-mode chunk loop, it calls fn-served-step once per socket read, and books/served states chunk independence of that very function: fn-served-step-partition-independence and fn-served-reply-stream-is-partition-independent. Open: the concurrent server (books/owner) does not certify, so this is exercised through the single-connection reader only. The current native owner uses fn-served-step-counted-fast via fn-owner-chunk and fn-ocfg-read-tls-prefix. Its fixed-spine guard and full-wire-invariant correspondence have focused certification; current outer owner correspondence and runtime integration remain open.

requirements.title: POST success is durable retained acceptance with safe retries
requirements.note: `books/nntp-post` and `books/owner` certify at their last green digests; what is missing is the theorem from the served `240` to the consumed completion (`fn-own-240-follows-consumed-completion`) and the native cut campaign on an image; both are T5. 2026-09-22 (T13-conform): an operator's retry of the same octets after a lost outcome resubmits the stored injection, so the store answers duplicate rather than a conflict (fn-own-operator-retry-resubmits-the-stored-injection, PRF-056); the Store comparison now runs in books/store-node.lisp fn-sn-existing-action, with exact outcome theorems and reachable teeth; the owner-to-Store retry composition is not yet a theorem.

requirements.title: NNTP views reflect complete committed membership
requirements.implementation_note: Actual recovered memberships feed LISTGROUP and filtered ACTIVE/NEWSGROUPS through ACL2. Independent client tests exact stored views. Complete reader/overview/profile guarantees remain open.
requirements.note: Certified on the farm gate of dev 7a9e89a (persvati, ACL2 8.7 / SBCL 2.6.8, 210 of 213 roots; the three that failed are the owner cluster). requirements.title: The session carries the archive-configuration verdict decided at open
requirements.implementation_note: fn-nntp-open-session runs the whole-archive recognizer once per connection and fn-nntp-step reads the carried verdict; an unrenderable committed article degrades only itself. Cursor behaviour under expiry or removal of a committed article remains open.
requirements.note: books/served certifies and fn-served-open now pins config and observation into the five-field connection, but no named theorem states that the verdict a session carries is the one decided at open, and the host that would exercise it (books/owner) does not certify.

requirements.title: NEWNEWS answers from this node’s durable acceptance stamp
requirements.implementation_note: RFC 3977 section 7.4 uses the existing section 7.3.2 date/time and wildmat parsers. For schema-1 articles it compares the owner’s durable whole-second acceptance stamp; schema-0 articles use the nearest later stamped acceptance, else the pinned reader wall second, else remain visible. One command scans the committed list once, reads no article payload octets, emits at most one line per matching candidate and has no parse-budget refusal.
requirements.note: The DATE-to-NEWNEWS no-miss guarantee across a reader pin and in-flight prepare remains T6 under A-CLOCK.

requirements.title: Host executes the proved core or a justified refinement
requirements.implementation_note: D07 requires a Python-free deployed Lisp node, operator CLI and helpers calling the executable ACL2 core. The frozen 03eb3ba native default/DTN images build from the recorded certified closure and pass their scoped owner/operator/storage/BP runtime suites, including public operator run and NNTP greeting/QUIT. Python is only an external test driver there. The full installed CLI/service, native outbound feed/protected transport/identity features and Python-free two-peer dependency gate remain open; the development bin/fn still invokes Python. The later native AUTHINFO startup receiver has scoped certified-image login evidence; it is not part of frozen03. Native public control/post is now integrated through fn-owner-control-submit and the shared completion helper, with separate ACL2 closure and exact-raw Darwin runtime evidence. Its clean combined image and complete installed two-peer gate remain open. The native outbound-feed component and credential administrator are integrated but await owner activation and public CLI composition respectively; their component evidence does not qualify the assembled service.
requirements.note: Owner and served components have since certified and the frozen cdbd6b2 Python service matrix ran with recorded disagreements; the earlier owner-does-not-certify blocker is historical. Neither those results nor native component tests establish HST-001 for the full native production service. Required: exact host-called subjects or named refinements, justified execution guards, and SCN-015 native deployment/dependency evidence; no status advancement follows from choosing D07. Selected 2026-09-23, implementation pending: raw store ROOT post is developer-only. Production default and DTN images must reject it with unsupported-entry exit 5 before store/payload I/O; production posting uses normal submission. Inspection/recovery remain available. SCN-015 must witness the profile boundary and ordinary posting; this selection does not advance requirement status.

requirements.title: Identified completions, serialization, bounded effects
requirements.implementation_note: Logical single-owner serialization is implemented. The frozen03 native runtime exercises concurrent uncertainty fencing and worker lifetime, with FNFD intent reconciliation after independent restart. Full concurrent backpressure, stale completion and production two-peer lifecycle composition remain open. The integrated control endpoint uses an adjacent persistent lease and worker-owned final socket close, with bounded accept polling for orderly SIGTERM. Scoped native collision, repeated-signal and lost-reply/restart tests passed. U18's active-client ceiling, absolute frame deadline and linear bounded accumulation are now integrated with scoped native slow-drip and excess-client witnesses; complete concurrent host refinement and the combined Linux image remain open.
requirements.note: Bounded protocol effects and scoped native mutex/worker runtime evidence are recorded separately. Frozen03 supersedes the historical owner-does-not-certify blocker; it does not establish complete serialization, backpressure or crash correspondence for every later native module.

requirements.title: Platform adapter meets the persistence contract
requirements.implementation_note: POSIX adapter has 47 enumerated syscall/completion fault rows, six process-death boundaries, ownership/lifecycle regressions and actual ACL2 reopen. Logical file and live completion correspondence are certified components. Hardware durability and complete host refinement remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open. W12 adds bounded ACL2 FNFD prefix recovery, durable torn-suffix repair and an owner-wide fence after ambiguous journal I/O. Its scanner/phase theorems and component tests are scoped by PRF-043; physical correspondence and integrated acceptance/feed recovery remain open. The pending native configuration-history observer now bounds physical enumeration, sends every retained name/octet pair to ACL2 for exact decode and canonical generation/name binding, and faults conflicting or malformed evidence instead of filtering it. Its source/raw tests pass; its corrected dependency closure and source-matched developer-image witness remain pending, and it does not establish whole-host or platform correspondence.
requirements.note: Integration-verified, and the first real evidence exists: tools/deploy_gate.py ran one commit as a service on persvati with a kill cut and a recovery. It records its own gaps -- the owner did not start, no independent nntplib decoder (the host has only Python 3.13.7 and PEP 594 removed it), no newsreader installed, one kill point, and a SIGKILL is not a power loss -- so the persistence contract is not met as written.

requirements.title: Certification and host trust boundaries are explicit
requirements.implementation_note: Logical certification excludes program-mode host helpers and retains ACL2/runtime/adapter assumptions. The host-called standalone store and shared-owner prepare projections are equated to the replaying specification and former owner event under relations established by observed open and preserved through the owner transition family; their executable bodies retain candidate and pending binding checks and omit the per-prepare appended-history replay. BP composition evidence records 11 scoped roots, unchanged source digests and 133 Python tests without an all-roots or power-loss claim. A separate seven-book inventory records the complete 41-function ADU guard graph and 97 remaining unverified BP functions. W14 adds a native libsodium primitive seam for the existing anchor Ed25519/SHA-512 profile with vector/negative and saved-image restart tests on the recorded hosts. Outbound implicit TLS and STARTTLS now have ACL2 phase policy plus native chain/hostname validation source and focused runtime evidence; raw OpenSSL/ABI behavior remains trusted and batch certification is pending. Complete physical correspondence and the saved-image owner gate for this revision remain open.
requirements.note: The trust boundary and the certification procedure are documented and the tooling now enforces part of it (tools/certs.py will not cache a pair except against a passed manifest, keyed on the whole include closure). What is missing for a status change is a theorem-level statement of the boundary, not a document. PRF-049 (plan T9, lane t9b-role, 2026-09-22): the principal-bound inbound peer role has keystones over fn-auth-step and fn-ocfg-open with teeth; the native reconnect on an image is still open.

requirements.title: A host fault costs one connection, not the service
requirements.implementation_note: The development Python owner has per-connection/per-peer fault boundaries; its reader/control coverage remains limited. Frozen03 native runtime now exercises ordinary disconnect isolation, uncertainty fencing under the shared mutex and worker cleanup. The native unexpected serious-condition handler still stops the whole service; attributable unexpected connection-local fault survival remains an implementation task, not discharged by a conservative global stop. Shared/core/persistence uncertainty must continue to fence the owner. Orderly SIGTERM is now integrated with scoped native shutdown/reopen evidence; it does not discharge unexpected connection-local fault survival.
requirements.note: The boundary is a model transition, not a Python decision: fn-own-fault (books/owner-fault.lisp) names the 403 line, closes the connection, clears its in-flight submission and its pending transaction, and is proved to leave every other connection equal to what it was. Measured: before it, an exception in Owner.drain ended the process for every connection, which is the single cause behind 33 blocked rows of the 190-row v0 matrix.

requirements.title: Statements travel as a canonical FN-Statement field
requirements.note: The books now exist: packet S1 landed `books/stx-carrier.lisp`, `books/stx-verify.lisp`, `books/stx-invariants.lisp` and `tests/acl2/stx-tests.lisp` on `dev`. `books/stx-carrier` IS certified (persvati `run-20260920T052853Z-b82b`, zero failures). Status does not move: `books/stx-verify` is open at `fn-stx-decimal-octets-are-printable` and `books/stx-invariants` and `tests/acl2/stx-tests` cascade off it, so no keystone of this requirement has certified. requirements.title: Scoped durable consumer progress for a sleeping agent
requirements.note: Selected v1 experiment, not a v0 gate. Native 1d26e01f passed signed local-owner poll, read-only repeat, advancing ACK with lost reply/recovery and clone-incarnation refusal; the separate Mini join established a durable application transaction before ACK. Native e160442f additionally passed local consumer status and exact-file projection bounds. The current source retrieves its at-most-16-event poll window through a maintained derived sequence index; scoped correspondence is certified, while the new topic/index composition still needs broad qualification and native cost/recovery evidence. Remote authenticated multi-group poll/ack/rebase, complete native physical crash refinement, durable reply publication and the full adversarial E2 trace set remain open. Journal-event distance is not article unreadness or application processing.

requirements.implementation_note: The bounded experimental fixed-controller ACL2 model now carries administrator installation, root anchor and report admission in Store slot 12, checks earlier T10 exact source and historical key context, finite quota, roster and same-topic parents, and replays topic history separately on reopen. The native owner/control source calls the ACL2 proposal dispatcher and publication gate; the joined Store/topic/index and status-scope roots have scoped persvati certification.
requirements.note: This local experiment is not a universal governance contract. A source-matched native install/root/report/reopen image, broad reverse closure and physical publication qualification remain open before served durable-admission status; succession, fork healing and automatic policy adoption are not inferred.
